[[File:Ruusan_Bat.jpg|thumb|right|200px|[[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]] bat]]
'''Bats''' were cave-dwelling winged [[Mammal/Legends|mammals]]. A [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]] was the [[Sand bat/Legends|sand bat]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Black bats occurred on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]], while green bats could be found on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].

[[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]] was home to black-furred, three-horned bats. [[Iego/Legends|Iego]] was the home environment of the [[Xandu/Legends|xandu]], a four-winged bat-like creature. Other animals similar to bats included [[Hawk-bat/Legends|hawk-bats]], [[bloodbat]]s, [[Ice Bat]]s, [[KyLessian fruit bat]]s, [[borgle bat]]s, and [[shredder bat]]s.
